scope: Public Japanese and English sponsorship page, including the expandable historical section.
supplied_materials_reviewed: Brand Sponsorship Proposal 2027, pp.2–3 and pp.15–18

findings.claim: 200 conference participants; 1,000 event participants; 43 media appearances; 13 outlets at the 2020 symposium; 16,000+ Facebook followers
findings.status: Historical organizer self-report, explicitly dated 2020-08-26. No underlying attendance ledgers, full coverage list or dated account analytics were available for this review.
findings.public_action: Withdraw the quoted totals from the sponsorship page. Do not treat them as false or replace them with newer, differently defined figures.

findings.claim: 15 places annually; 300–400 Myanmar applicants; about 40 Japanese applicants; selection measuring English, teamwork and critical thinking
findings.status: Original organizer copy located. Annual applicant records and selection rubric were not available; 2027 documents do not substantiate these annual totals.
findings.public_action: Withdraw the quoted applicant totals and selection claims.

findings.claim: Myanmar participants are in the top few percent and come from wealthy families
findings.status: Unsupported inference. An acceptance ratio does not establish academic rank or household finances. No records support the assertion.
findings.public_action: Withdraw the heading and paragraph; remove the related top-student wording from the current page introduction.

findings.claim: Guaranteed prominent logos, Facebook posts, state-TV exposure, booths, free sponsor dinners and recruiting/hiring cases
findings.status: Found in the legacy recruitment copy. Current supplied sponsorship documents do not establish these guarantees, access conditions or historical hiring cases.
findings.public_action: Withdraw the guarantees; direct readers to discuss logo placement, event participation, costs and conditions individually.

retained: Existing supporter logos and assistance/sponsorship/endorsement hierarchy
Supplied original documents as documents; legacy recruitment materials are explicitly identified as past terms
research_limit: This is a review of available organizer materials and public sources, not an audit of internal registers or sponsor agreements. Failure to corroborate a claim does not demonstrate it is false.
